text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Organisasi

Antarabangsa (Keistimewaan dan Kekebalan) (Pertubuhan Gerakan Pengakap

Sedunia) 2018.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna

yang lain—

"Pegawai" ertinya pegawai Pertubuhan Gerakan Pengakap Sedunia yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual;

"Setiausaha Agung" ertinya orang yang dilantik oleh Ahli Jawatankuasa Pengakap

Sedunia dan merupakan ketua pegawai tadbir Pertubuhan Gerakan Pengakap Sedunia;

dan

"WOSM" ertinya "Pertubuhan Gerakan Pengakap Sedunia" yang ditadbir oleh

perlembagaannya dan wakil-wakil yang diiktiraf oleh Anggota Pertubuhan yang telah

mengamalkan dan mempraktikkan Pergerakan Pengakap yang diasaskan pada 1907,

yang telah berhimpun di Paris, Perancis, pada Julai 1992 dan telah menubuhkan

Persidangan Pengakap Antarabangsa bagi menyelaraskan Pergerakan Pengakap

di seluruh dunia bersama-sama dengan Jawatankuasa Eksekutif dan Sekretariat.

Pengisytiharan WOSM sebagai organisasi antarabangsa

3. WOSM diisytiharkan menjadi suatu organisasi antarabangsa yang baginya

seksyen 4 Akta terpakai.

Keperibadian juridikal

4. WOSM hendaklah mempunyai keperibadian juridikal dan hendaklah mempunyai

keupayaan—

(a) untuk membuat kontrak;

(b) untuk memperoleh dan melupuskan harta alih dan harta tak alih; dan

(c) untuk memulakan dan menjadi pihak kepada prosiding undang-undang.

Keistimewaan WOSM

5. (1) WOSM hendaklah mempunyai keistimewaan yang dinyatakan dalam

perenggan 5, 6 dan 7 Jadual Pertama Akta.

(2) WOSM hendaklah bekerjasama pada setiap masa dan hendaklah

memastikan Pegawai bekerjasama pada setiap masa dengan pihak berkuasa

Kerajaan Malaysia bagi memudahkan pentadbiran keadilan yang sewajarnya, menjamin

pematuhan undang-undang domestik dan mencegah berlakunya apa-apa salah guna

keistimewaan yang diperuntukkan di bawah Peraturan 5 dan 6.

Keistimewaan Pegawai

6. Seseorang Pegawai, selain warganegara atau penduduk tetap Malaysia, hendaklah

mempunyai keistimewaan yang dinyatakan dalam perenggan 2 dan 7 Bahagian I Jadual

Keempat Akta.

INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS (PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES) ACT 1992

INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS (PRIVILEGES AND IMMUNITIES) (THE WORLD

ORGANIZATION OF THE SCOUT MOVEMENT) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsections 3(1) and 4(1) and section 11

of the International Organizations (Privileges and Immunities) Act 1992 [Act 485],

the Minister, with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance, makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as International Organizations (Privileges

and Immunities) (The World Organization of The Scout Movement)

Regulations 2018.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—

"Officer" means the officer of the World Organization of the Scout Movement

specified in the Schedule;

"Secretary General" means the person appointed by the World Scout Committee

and is the chief administrative officer of the World Organization of the Scout Movement;

and

"WOSM" means the World Organization of the Scout Movement which is governed

by its constitution and the accredited representatives of Member Organizations which

had adopted and practiced the Scout Movement founded in 1907, assembled in Paris,

France, in July 1992 and established the International Scout Conference for the

coordination of the Scout Movement throughout the world together with

an Executive Committee and a Secretariat.

Declaration of WOSM to be an international organization

3. WOSM is declared to be an international organization to which section 4 of

the Act applies.

Juridical personality

4. WOSM shall have juridical personality and shall have the capacity—

(a) to contract;

(b) to acquire and dispose immovable and movable property; and

(c) to institute and be party to legal proceedings.

Privileges of WOSM

5. (1) WOSM shall have the privileges specified in paragraphs 5, 6 and 7 of the

First Schedule of the Act.

(2) WOSM shall cooperate at all times and shall procure that the Officer

co-operate at all times with appropriate authority of the Government of Malaysia to

facilitate the proper administration of justice, to secure the observance of domestic

legislation and to prevent the occurrence of any abuse in connection with the privileges

accorded under Regulations 5 and 6.

Privileges of Officer

6. An Officer, other than a citizen or permanent resident of Malaysia, shall have the

privileges specified in paragraphs 2 and 7 of Part I of the Fourth Schedule of the Act.
